meta.note: Per-round regeneration and per-day natural healing. Bleeding per round stays in scripts/bleeding.py (docs/BLEEDING.md).

natural_healing.destroyed_zone_note: A zone at 0 (crippled/severed) does not heal by itself: surgery/magic/GM.

Ogre.source: rules/races.json 'High Caloric Need & Fast Healing': heal 50% faster for non-severed wounds as long as fed

Dwarf.source: rules/lore/dwarves.json bleed_duration_multiplier 0.8 (no healing-speed trait in data)

corrupted_regeneration.note: Regeneration only removes normal damage. Damage from a full-Breath knight is not regenerated and heals naturally at x0.5.

breath_wounds.fairness: Cuts still clot (only slower) and the 5 HP/round bleeding cap still applies.

morale_vs_knight.rule: d100 <= base + WIL//5 + breath_mod passes. Fail = pick another target if one is available; otherwise it still attacks. A test, never automatic.
